title: One-off Coverage Priority Calculator
content:
Purpose:
Lightweight spreadsheet for triaging a grab-bag of coverage/owner items that popped up post-release. Not intended to replace formal backlog — goal is quick, defensible prioritization + who to ping.

Scoring logic (single-line):
priority_score = round( (impact_score * 0.5) + (customer_exposure * 0.3) + ((5 - estimated_effort_tier) * 0.2), 2 )
- impact_score: 1 (low) .. 5 (severe product/regression)
- customer_exposure: 1 (internal) .. 5 (large number of paying customers)
- estimated_effort_tier: 1 (small <1d) .. 5 (major >10d)

Table (rows are current items — shorthand, update in-place):

| id | item_title | tentative_owner | upstream_dependency | impact | exposure | effort_tier | priority_score | notify | quick_notes |
| 1 | noncritical-reroute-on-404 | Lucas Chen | infra-config (edge-lb) | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2.10 | @oncall-team | intermittent 404s reported by SE; low customer-visible but spikes in ops pager mid-day. Investigate headers + edge rule.
| 2 | fallback-model-route-mismatch | Maya Alvarez | serving-runtime rollout (#412) | 4 | 4 | 3 | 3.70 | @se-rotation, @infra | Canary saw misrouted fallback -> elevated latency. Suggest hotfix guardrail and canary rollback if next 24h fails.
| 3 | embeddings-cost-aberration | Aisha Khan | billing+optimize heuristics | 3 | 3 | 4 | 2.90 | @fin-ops, @optimize | Sudden transient cost for small customers on nightly runs. Short-term throttle rule recommended + metric alert tweak.
| 4 | private-deploy-metadata-sync | Tomás Rivera | private-deploy agents | 2 | 1 | 1 | 2.30 | @se-team | metadata miss on older agent versions; low impact but easy patch.
| 5 | console-route-flap | Priya Menon | frontend-assets CDN | 5 | 5 | 5 | 3.50 | @console-oncall, @network | Customer-facing console unavailable for 30m yesterday. High-customer impact; requires cross-team blameless postmortem and priority fix work.
| 6 | docs-mislink-usage-FAQ | Maya Alvarez | docs repo | 1 | 2 | 1 | 2.00 | @docs | Low effort; fix link and small blurb. Schedule in next docs sprint.

Quick interpretation notes:
- Immediate top candidates for action: id 2 (fallback mismatch) and id 5 (console outage). Id 2 has higher chance of cascading latency to other customers; we propose a 24h hotfix + canary guard. Id 5 requires incident owners to confirm rollback windows + priority slot.
- Medium follow-ups: id 3 cost aberration — create a temporary throttle policy, then deep dive during next Optimize sync.
- Low-effort ops: id 4 & id 6 can be scheduled into patching lanes; id 1 is mild but monitor.

Suggested micro-runbook (to use for quick owner handoff):
- Owner ack in 2 hours for items with priority_score >= 3.5 (tag: immediate).
- Owners to post a 1-paragraph plan in this sheet under 'quick_notes' and DM the listed notify handle.
- If cross-team dependency exists, owner creates a short Confluence child note and links back (use template: "mini-postmortem-lite").

Next actions (checklist):
- [ ] Lucas: reproduce 404 spike and add request/response sample to JIRA JIRA-OPS-981 by EOD + set a 48h sampling alert.
- [ ] Maya: prepare canary rollback plan and one-line hotfix description; sync with infra in next 1 hour.
- [ ] Aisha: temp throttle rule drafted and applied to a single customer cohort; report delta in costs in 48h.
- [ ] Tomás: ship metadata-sync patch to agent 1.12.1; validation in sandbox.
- [ ] Priya: lead cross-team blameless on console outage; draft postmortem template link in this doc.

Operational heuristics / rules-of-thumb (short):
- Use this sheet for 1-off triage only; anything that needs >5d work should be converted to a proper ticket and backloged.
- If priority_score ties, prefer owner availability (who can act in the next 24h) and customer-facing impact.

Audit trail snippets (notes of actions taken):
- 2028-11-08 09:14 Lucas added request dump from region-us-west-2 -> attached to JIRA-OPS-981.
- 2028-11-08 10:02 Maya annotated rollback plan in internal slack thread (#rollbacks) and pinged infra lead @henry.

Freeform scribbles (notes to self):
- consider adding a tiny weighted 'regression-risk' slider next iteration (esp for rollout-linked items).
- maybe export to email digest for execs if console outages breach 60m in a week.

Contacts quick list (if you don't know who to ping):
- infra: Henry Cole (henry@redwood.com)
- serving/runtime: Jun Park (jun@redwood.com)
- optimize: Aisha Khan (aisha@redwood.com)
- console: Priya Menon (priya@redwood.com)

Last quick decision: set "owner ack in 2 hours" rule now; owners assigned to items 2 & 5 to convene an immediate 15m triage.

End of sheet (lightweight) — keep editing in place; ephemeral tracker for the release window.
